verses.yusufAli: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath)
verses.sale: By the war-horses which run swiftly to the battle, with a panting noise

verses.t: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
verses.rodwell: And those that dash off sparks of fire
verses.sale: and by those which strike fire, by dashing their hoofs against the stones

verses.pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn
verses.yusufAli: And push home the charge in the morning
verses.rodwell: And those that scour to the attack at morn
verses.sale: and by those which make a sudden incursion on the enemy early in the morning

verses.pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust
verses.yusufAli: And raise the dust in clouds the while
verses.rodwell: And stir therein the dust aloft

verses.t: Arriving thereby in the center collectively
verses.pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe)
verses.yusufAli: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse
verses.rodwell: And cleave therein their midway through a host
verses.sale: and therein pass through the midst of the adverse troops

verses.t: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful
verses.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
verses.yusufAli: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful
verses.rodwell: Truly, Man is to his Lord ungrateful
verses.sale: Verily man is ungrateful unto his Lord

verses.t: And indeed, he is to that a witness
verses.pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that
verses.yusufAli: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds)
verses.rodwell: And of this he is himself a witness

verses.t: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense
verses.pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent
verses.yusufAli: And violent is he in his love of wealth
verses.rodwell: And truly, he is vehement in the love of this world's good
verses.sale: And he is immoderate in the love of worldly good

verses.t: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
verses.pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
verses.yusufAli: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
verses.rodwell: Ah! knoweth he not, that when that which is in the graves shall be laid bare
verses.sale: Doth he not know, therefore, when that which is in the graves shall be taken forth

verses.t: And that within the breasts is obtained
verses.pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known
verses.yusufAli: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest
verses.rodwell: And that which is in men's breasts shall be brought forth
verses.sale: and that which is in men's breasts shall be brought to light

verses.t: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted
verses.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them
verses.yusufAli: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day
verses.rodwell: Verily their Lord shall on that day be informed concerning them
verses.sale: that their Lord will, on that day, be fully informed concerning them
